instructions.task: Classify this tweet under a hate-speech annotation policy that covers hate against immigrants/refugees and hostile, demeaning use of gendered slurs. Pick the option that best describes the tweet.
notes: For immigration tweets, judge whether immigrants themselves are insulted or framed negatively. Slogans and hashtags like #BuildTheWall, #SendThemBack, #IllegalAliens, plain wall/border policy support, or a bare demand to deport are not enough. A derogatory name for immigrants counts even inside a hashtag (e.g. #Rapefugees).

For tweets using bitch, hoe, whore or cunt, judge the hostility. It is hate when the slur is used with hostility against a specific person, whatever their gender: telling them off or to back off ('bitch stop it', 'bitch thats my cousin hoe cool your beans'), telling them to shut up, insulting their looks or intelligence, stacked insults, or wishing them harm. It is not hate when addressing a friend playfully ('bitch you scared me', 'bitch you guessed it'), as an interjection ('BITCH HOLD UP'), in the author boasting about themselves ('ion take you hoes serious'), in lyrics, about oneself, when reporting what someone called you, or as an offhand jab at an unknown person.

Also hate: portraying immigrants (including Muslim immigrants) as destroying the country or its culture, or as a frightening threat (e.g. Sharia), while calling to keep them out or send them back. Not hate: disparaging a foreign country itself ('Brazil is a sh*thole') without characterising immigrants, or a string of political hashtags with no words of its own about immigrants.

Not hate: claims about parties or policies ('open borders mean crime', 'a red wave brings safety') that do not portray immigrants themselves; a factual news headline about a crime by a specific immigrant shared without the author adding hostility or a generalisation; subtweets aimed at unnamed people ('bitches wanna post thinking it's about them, like bitch this shoe don't fit', 'WELLL bitch you put your whole life on here').

Hate (immigrants) also covers brief or mild claims in the author's own words that immigrants or immigration harm the country: a burden ('we are giving our country away', 'we cannot sustain this'), 'it's getting worse every day' about immigration, or presenting diversity as proof of #WhiteGenocide. Hate (gendered slurs) also covers expressing hatred of, or threatening to fight, a group of women addressed with slurs ('I hate you', 'disrespect with you whores and I will handle mine'), even without a specific target.

Contempt, disgust or sexual degradation aimed at women as a class of 'bitches/hoes/whores' is hate even with no specific target ('I don't fuck with none of y'all bitch ass whores', 'Instagram hoes have herpes', 'a hoe is that bitch that let a team run a train on her', 'bitches hollering it's too hot ... go back to winter hoe').

Joking or boasting about raping or sexually assaulting a woman ('u scared to rape a bitch? I cant relate') is hate. Casual advice or commands with a trailing 'bitch' ('drink a whole glass of water right now bitch') are friendly, not hate.
Not hate: slurs aimed at men ('many of you so called men are bitch made hoes', 'he a whole bitch bro') and the idiom 'son of a bitch'.

Also: 'whoever took my shoes / whoever unfollowed me, you a bitch' is an offhand jab at an unknown person, not hate. 'We would be swamped with millions like you' or 'we can't take in all the world's refugees' is a negative claim about immigrants, so it is hate.

Not hate: approving remarks or sayings ('I heard that bitch stay on her shit, you KNOW THE HOE LOYAL', 'you can rent a hoe but you cant buy a bitch'). Hate: insulting the immigrant in a crime story or wishing them thrown out violently ('THROW THIS POS over it').

Hate: crime stories about immigrants used with punitive demands (#DeathPenalty, 'anything less is not justice', #DeportThemAll). Not hate: purely legal or procedural arguments ('if illegal aliens don't like being called illegal they shouldn't break the law; follow the protocols or stay home'); quoting a politician's view on where refugees should go ('Why don't Qatar and Saudi take Muslim refugees? - Polish MP').
Hate: sarcastic contempt for immigrants ('Pelosi's precious illegal aliens! #DeportThemAll'); quoting or recalling a rape joke or lyric ('rape a pregnant bitch').

Not hate: hostile slurs aimed at men, at a politician over policy ('you answer us dirtbag bitch' about the wall), or at gender-neutral groups ('Stupid cunts' at polluters). Hate: treating women as sexual conquests or possessions ('I bet I'll make that hoe my bitch', 'these niggas fuck 12 bitches').

Not hate: negative hashtags (#ImmigrationIsAWeapon, #WhiteGenocide, #StopTheInvasion) attached to a news link or to text about something else (activists, media) without the author's own negative words about immigrants. Still hate: a personal attack with stacked slurs where the target is not clearly male ('MOTHERFUCKING BITCH ... CUNTBAG', 'Bitch stop it, bum ass hoe you lame as hell').

Not hate: a shared headline or link title (books, media, politics, propaganda claims) followed by hashtags such as #WhiteGenocide or #StopTheInvasion; economic-policy claims about a program ('DACA lowers wages, need E-Verify'); self-referential interjections ('Bitch I like to smoke I'm living the life hoes'). Hate: a headline about an immigrant's crime paired with punitive or expulsion demands (#DeportThemAll, #DeathPenalty); dismissing women as 'you hoes' with contempt ('ain't nann one of you hoes paying my bills').

criteria.imm_slogan_or_policy: Immigration or border politics with no insult or negative framing of immigrants themselves: slogans, hashtags only, wall or border policy support, a bare demand to deport or send them back, rally posts, attacks on politicians, neutral news. Also purely legal or procedural arguments, and quoted politicians' views on where refugees should go. Also news links or other topics with only negative hashtags. Also shared headlines on other topics with hashtags only, and economic-policy claims about programs.
criteria.imm_negative_framing: Frames immigrants/refugees negatively as a group: an invasion, criminals or rapists (including crime stories about an illegal alien used to argue against immigrants), a burden on welfare or taxpayers, stealing jobs or IDs, carrying disease, destroying the country. Also: immigrants destroying the country or its culture, or a frightening threat (Sharia), used to argue for keeping them out. Includes brief claims that immigration harms the country (giving our country away, can't sustain, getting worse, diversity as white genocide). Also: 'we would be swamped with millions', 'can't take in all the world's refugees'. Also crime stories with punitive demands.
criteria.imm_insult: Insults, dehumanises or shows contempt for immigrants/refugees or the people to be deported (scum, POS, animals, pig fuckers, rapefugees), mocks or celebrates their suffering (cages, 'you suffer the consequences'), tells them to go back with racial contempt, or wishes harm on them. Also insulting the immigrant in a crime story or wishing them thrown out violently ('THROW THIS POS over it'). Also sarcastic contempt for immigrants ('Pelosi's precious illegal aliens! #DeportThemAll').
criteria.slur_friendly: Uses bitch/hoe etc. without hostility: addressing a friend playfully ('bitch you scared me', 'bitch you guessed it'), an interjection ('BITCH HOLD UP', 'bitch please'), about oneself, lyrics or quotes, reporting what someone called you, or about an object or situation. Includes casual advice or commands with a trailing 'bitch' ('drink a whole glass of water right now bitch'). Also approving remarks or sayings ('I heard that bitch stay on her shit, you KNOW THE HOE LOYAL', 'you can rent a hoe but you cant buy a bitch').
criteria.slur_mild_jab: The author boasting about themselves ('ion take you hoes serious', 'good luck finding a faithful bitch like me'), a subtweet about someone thinking a post is about them, or an offhand jab at an unknown person or a man ('whoever took the last pair, you a bitch 😒', 'boy you a hoe'). Also slurs aimed at men, and 'son of a bitch'. Also 'whoever took my shoes / unfollowed me is a bitch'. Also hostile slurs at men, politicians or gender-neutral groups.
criteria.slur_hostile_attack: Uses gendered slurs with hostility against a specific person: telling them off or to back off ('bitch stop it', 'bitch thats my cousin hoe cool your beans'), telling them to shut up, insulting their looks or intelligence along with bitch/hoe/whore/cunt, stacked insults, or wishing them harm. Stacked slurs at someone not clearly male count.
criteria.misogyny_general: Contempt, disgust or sexual degradation aimed at women as a class of 'bitches/hoes/whores' ('y'all bitch ass whores', 'Instagram hoes have herpes', 'a hoe is that bitch that let a team run a train on her'), saying women are inferior, saying 'I hate you' to women addressed with slurs, or threatening to fight or assault women. Includes joking or boasting about rape or sexual violence against a woman. Also quoting or recalling a rape joke or lyric ('rape a pregnant bitch'). Also women as sexual conquests or possessions. Also contemptuous dismissal of 'you hoes'.
criteria.other_not_hate: Anything else: no immigration angle and no gendered slur, or insults with no slur and no immigrant target.
